name: SABnzbd queue
description: What SABnzbd is downloading: speed, time left and each download's progress. You choose which categories show their names; the rest appear as "Other download" or not at all.

options.label: SABnzbd address
options.help: As the Vital Signs server reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080

options.label: API key
options.help: In SABnzbd: Config, General, Security, API Key. It stays on the server. Leave blank when editing to keep the stored one.

options.label: Categories that show download names
options.help: Downloads in any other category, including ones you add to SABnzbd later, never have their name or category sent to the screen.

choices.label: Show them as "Other download" (progress and size only)
Say so (a split screen pane can hide or show something else instead)
